negotiation_id.description: Optional (v0.4). Opaque id shared by every message of one negotiation chain, across proposal_ids. A receiver SHOULD cap rounds per negotiation_id (default 3) and MUST reject a message over its cap with a reason starting with negotiation_limit:.

version.description: Optional on-wire protocol version. Canonical value is "0.4". A v0.4 receiver also accepts the 0.3 line ("0.3", "0.3.x") and processes it under v0.4 rules. Values with a leading v (e.g. "v0.4") are treated as unknown and MUST be rejected.
